text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having sprinted through three years in the Twinkle Series,
one day, after reaching a major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mooom, I don't get it!
What's so good about it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is going on?
...Well, you see.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: I wanna give Papa and Mama a present, y'know? Like, to say thanks for everything?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: She cheered for me during the Twinkle Series too, giving me strength and all.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Sooo,
come shopping with me♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I had just come out to go shopping,
but—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I totally thought I'd get struck with inspiration once I hit the shops☆
...but I have way less of a clue than I thought...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"A watch? But Papa already has a really nice one.
A handkerchief? But Mama already has a really nice one, too."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Matching glasses? A tie? A scarf?
Oh, maybe a pair of travel tickets—
Ugh, but isn't all of that way too cliché by now???

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I reference her parents' hobbies and preferences,
I might come up with a good idea, but—
choice_data_list: What are your parents' favorite things?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to find an answer,
I noticed the sun had already set.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah~~~!
I couldn't even buy it in the end~!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed. I worried and fretted so much over it
that I failed to find it entirely.
choice_data_list: At this point... maybe something orthodox like a bouquet of flowers?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Nooo, if we do that, they'll just praise me a bunch and that's it!
I want a present that'll make them totally bawl their eyes out~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Parents", "bawling their eyes out"...
Those words made something click for me.
choice_data_list: Pandora, why don't you write a letter?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Huh, a letteeer—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"A letter!
Right, that's it, that's totally it!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: There's no way Papa and Mama wouldn't cry over a letter from me~!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
Pan-chan...!
A letter of gratitude for her papas!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I poured my heart into writing it,
so you'd better treasure it♡

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Mother
text_block_list.text:
What an admirable, sweet, and kind girl you are...!
I will treasure this for the rest of my life! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Ehe, ehehehehe~!

text_block_list.name: Pandora's Father
text_block_list.text:
You too, Trainer!
Thank you so much for raising this girl so wonderfully over these past three years!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, her parents shed tears reading the letter, and shed even more tears at Fusaichi Pandora's heartfelt words of gratitude; in any case—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Operation: Letter from Pandora
was a super duper massive success! ♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Feeling the warmth and family love between
Fusaichi Pandora and her parents made it
a truly heartwarming day—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Aaaand this is for Trainer too!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...It's not like anything major is written here, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Still, as I was writing a letter to say thank you to Mom and Dad—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
(“Thanks for always cheering for me
and worrying about me.
Believe in me—”)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: (Wait, is Trainer like that too?)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Somehow, I kinda felt like
writing one for you too, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“......Aha♡
Well? Ain't that admirable~? Makes you wanna cry, right~?”
choice_data_list: Of course, I'm so happy. Thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehe. I know, right?
I thought so♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Arriving home, I opened the letter with bated breath.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Honestly, at first, I only picked you as my Trainer 'cause it looked like you'd pamper me~ but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the single sheet of stationery, filled from top to bottom
with round, bubbly handwriting, was written—

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
“—Please keep being
my Trainer from here on out, okay?”

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Buy that limited-edition pudding for me again, okay?
Let's go on another trip to Hokkaido, too!"

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: "Even if I keep losing non-stop from here on, or if I'm past my peak..."

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Please stay as my Trainer until the very end.
Pretty please?♡"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was filled with endless pages of selfish requests—each one unmistakably her.
